messages.subject: Sanjay | Mining, Metals & Energy Executive | Government Relations, ESG and GCC Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Sanjay,

Your executive-search work across mining, metals, energy, oil and gas, infrastructure and the GCC makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where operating leadership depends on government relations, ESG, social performance and disciplined stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My work also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage, carbon-data readiness and responsible mining. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track opportunities across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership.

Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets for my next move, and I am open to expatriate, residential and rotational assignments across the wider GCC and other international markets.

I have attached a mining and energy-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or upcoming mandates where this background fits.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
